tools.name: find_judges
tools.description: Find likely US judges by name, court, state, county, or jurisdiction. Use this before requesting a profile when the exact KnowJudges slug is unknown. Results are public, bounded, and link to canonical KnowJudges profiles.

tools.name: find_ai_abuse_cases
tools.description: Find court decisions involving AI-generated legal errors. Returns at most 10 source-linked cases with court, judges, response, summary, and a verified official decision URL when available. Empty and bulk searches are unavailable.

tools.name: get_judge_profile
tools.description: Return a public KYJ judge profile with scope-aware findings, official source links, evidence excerpts, and verification metadata. Do not present courtwide guidance as a judge's personal preference.

tools.name: get_judge_biography
tools.description: Return source-attributed public biographical facts for a judge, including birth details, computed age, education, professional and judicial careers, provenance, coverage gaps, and verification status. Demographic and political labels are excluded from this public tool.

tools.name: get_courtroom_presentation_rules
tools.description: Get source-linked courtroom technology and presentation rules for a judge. Optional topics can focus on PowerPoint, video, demonstratives, advance exchange, exhibits, or courtroom technology.

tools.name: get_recent_rule_changes
tools.description: Return recorded KYJ profile or courtroom-rule changes since a date. Change tracking begins at the launch date, so an empty result does not prove that no earlier real-world rule changed.
